description: This file defines configuration classes, interfaces, and extension methods for setting up persistent streaming in Orleans, specifically for cluster client configurations. It includes mechanisms to configure stream pub/sub types, lifecycle options, and a concrete configurator class for cluster client persistent streams.

classes.name: ClusterClientPersistentStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Client-side configuration provider for persistent streams, allowing setup of stream pub/sub types and lifecycle options.

methods.name: ConfigureStreamPubSub
methods.description: Extension method to configure the stream pub/sub type for a persistent stream configurator.

methods.name: ConfigureLifecycle
methods.description: Extension method to configure the lifecycle options for a cluster client persistent stream.

methods.name: ClusterClientPersistentStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the configurator with necessary dependencies and setting up streaming components.
